headline: Israeli air strike k!lls a UN Palestinian agency worker in northern Gaza
label: NEWS
caption:
An Israeli air strike has k!lled a man working for the UN Palestinian refugee agency in the Gaza Strip. 🕊️

According to the relief agency and local health officials, the strike happened on Monday near a water well in the Jabalia refugee camp in the northern part of the enclave.

Medics named the k!lled Palestinian man as Adel al Helo, while three other people were wounded in the same attack.

Separate reports also noted that another Palestinian was k!lled by Israeli fire in northern Gaza, and a child d!ed of acute lead poisoning.
